readerCopy.body: An old version of you may be getting more attention than the one you are trying to become. When the Sun conjuncts the South Node, recognition can gather around a role, title, talent, or identity you already know how to carry. The praise may be deserved, and the opportunity may still be useful, but familiarity can make yesterday’s version of success feel more important than it is. Take what still belongs to you. You do not have to keep organizing your life around the part everyone already knows.
